name: v21b_wasp_range
description: Wasps starve at 4 despite 1300 fly prey — nest-bound with home_range 40, can't reach the dispersed flies (free-roaming centipedes, no range limit, thrive on the same flies). Widen wasp predation.home_range 40->80 so the nest can hunt the abundant flies. One lever; expect wasps to feed -> found daughter nests -> crop the fly boom (emergent predator-prey).
